data.title: Hills Park
data.about:
Located in the heart of a vibrant community, Hills Park offers a world of recreation, entertainment, and comfort right to your doorstep.

 An elegant selection of one, two, and three-bedroom apartments that exude elegance. This community-driven neighborhood just steps away from a multitude of retail, dining, and entertainment options while also being adjacent to beautifully manicured lawns.

location_tile.title: Come home to the Dubai Hills Estate
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Hills Park is conveniently located just minutes from Downtown Dubai and other business, retail, and tourism hubs via Al Khail Road. The proximity to anticipated Etihad Rail and Dubai Metro lines will allow for quick and easy access to airports and other emirates in the near future.

  • 15 Mins – Downtown Dubai
  • 15 Mins – Dubai Marina
  • 20 Mins – Dubai International Airport
  • 20 Mins – Maktoum International Airport

seo.metaTitle: Luxury Apartments at Hills Park by Emaar, Dubai
seo.metaDescription: Hills Park by Emaar offers elegant 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments in a vibrant community. Enjoy easy access to retail, dining, and lush green spaces nearby.
